item.title: Welcome to Paradise - Episode Summary for Monday, 26 October 2026
item.description: This episode covers major global and regional developments including the UN's concerns over Israel's displacement operations in Hebron, Brazil's historic presidential election comeback by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Serbia's Student List movement preparing to form government, Algeria's first foreign military deployment since 1973, and the financial insights from Anthropic's IPO filing.
